title: Change Authorised Bank Signatories
description: Adds, removes, or replaces the directors/officers authorised to operate an existing company bank account.

questions.label: How many clear days' notice was given for this meeting?
How many directors are present at this meeting?
Name of the signatory being added/removed/replaced
Name of the signatory being replaced

template.agendaTitle: To change the authorised signatories on the Company's bank account
template.proposal: It is proposed to update the list of persons authorised to operate the Company's account with {{bank_name}}, {{branch_name}} Branch (A/c no. ending {{account_number}}). The Board members discussed and approved the following resolution.
template.body:
"RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 179 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Articles of Association of the Company, {{signatory_name}}, {{signatory_designation}}, be and is hereby {{#if outgoing_signatory_name}}substituted in place of {{outgoing_signatory_name}} as an{{else}}{{change_type}}ed as a{{/if}} authorised signatory for operating the Company's account with {{bank_name}}, {{branch_name}} Branch.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Bank be and is hereby requested to note this change and to honour cheques, instruments and instructions signed accordingly, and to disregard the authority of any signatory so removed with immediate effect.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT any one Director of the Company be and is hereby authorised to sign and submit the Bank's own signatory-change form and any other document required to give effect to this resolution, and to file necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies, {{roc_jurisdiction}}, if applicable."
template.minutesGist: Meeting held on {{meeting_date}} at {{meeting_place}}. The Board approved a change to the authorised signatories on the Company's account with {{bank_name}}, {{branch_name}} Branch, as set out in the resolution above.

change_type.meaning: Whether a signatory is being added, removed, or swapped for another.
change_type.tip: Most banks require their own signatory-change form in addition to a certified copy of this resolution — check the bank's specific requirement before submission.
